title: Speed: default values
prompt:
SPEED DRILL — target under 90 seconds.

What is printed?

```java
int[] a = new int[3];
a[1]++;
System.out.println(a[0] + a[1] + a[2]);
```

A. 0
B. 1
C. 2
D. ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException

Call `answer(...)` exactly once with your option letter and a one-sentence reason.

tests.name: B speed
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.answer("B. check"));
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("B"), "answer must start with the correct option letter");
tests.hint: B. int arrays start at 0; a[1]++ makes exactly one cell 1; the sum is 1. A forgets the increment; D invents an out-of-bounds that never happens.
